transcript: I will always readjust as necessary because this is just life. Life is what it is, and in accepting that, I have learned that I don't need to carry baggage from the past and I don't need to create fake weight from the future. It is my job to live in this present moment and explore this life at its fullest capacity. And for me, that looks like being willing to readjust, willing to take a step back, being willing to move on. I am always willing to move.
